name: Nishma Shah
headline: Head of Delivery | Fintech, Rewards and Card-linked offers | Scaling products, Partners and Revenue
location: The Rocks, New South Wales, Australia
position: Head of Delivery, Platforms and Partnerships
about:
As head of delivery, I sit at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships and commercial outcomes. My focus is simple: making sure what we build drives revenue, adoption and scale.
 
Over the past 20+ years, I have worked across fintech, rewards and card-linked ecosystems, owning end-to-end product management and now delivery from onboarding partners and launching products to scaling platforms across markets.
… more

experiences.position: Head of Delivery, Platforms and Partnerships
experiences.description:
I lead delivery as a core business function, ensuring product execution, partner onboarding and platform performance directly contribute to revenue, adoption and scale.

Having transitioned from product into delivery, I bring a strong understanding of both strategy and execution, ensuring what gets built is aligned to commercial outcomes and can scale effectively.

Working across product, engineering, partnerships and commercial teams to translate strategy into execution, align priorities and remove friction to accelerate delivery outcomes.

I own end-to-end delivery across product, client onboarding and partner integrations, including execution of the card-linked offers platform and open banking solutions across multiple clients and publisher ecosystems. This includes onboarding enterprise partners through API and custom integration models, with a focus on scalable and commercially viable solutions.

I focus on improving operational efficiency by reducing time to onboard and launch new partners and clients, while implementing structured delivery frameworks, processes and governance across the organisation.

I work closely with leadership to prioritise roadmap initiatives based on commercial impact and scalability, supporting revenue growth through faster go-to-market and improved partner performance.

Contributing to clients' product team and ensuring consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team whilst contributing to their passion and their ideas. Providing best solutions to the problems that need to be solved for our clients and contributing to the knowledge of clients’ customers, and the data about how their customers engage with their products.

experiences.position: Senior Manager - New Products & Strategy at Wpay
experiences.description: Defining, reviewing, and driving new digital products and business propositions to enhance customer experience for Consumers and Merchants across the Group retail stores. Prototyping new innovations with the wider payments innovation team. Building out and defining the opportunities into new customer value propositions and products through customer research and testing.

Developed strategy within new retail technology using machine learning and autonomous platforms to enhance customer experience. Built and led a cross-functional product team from inception to delivery within Woolworths Digital payments and services. Oversaw market research including opportunity analysis, competitive analysis, direct and indirect customer requirements gathering and analysis.
